name: prov-invalid
comment: The FAIL cases of app/specs/prov/spec.json ('tests' there pins each one), byte for byte as W3C serves them, with the answers that file gives: the acceptance vectors of the guest 'prov-invalid', which is the same module as 'prov'. One guest build carries at most about 110 vectors, so the PASS cases are the vectors of 'prov' and the FAIL cases are this guest's.
examples:
check
document
prefix ex <http://example.org/>
entity(ex:e1)
entity(ex:e2)
wasGeneratedBy(ex:gen1;ex:e1,-,-)
wasGeneratedBy(ex:gen2;ex:e2,-,-)
wasDerivedFrom(ex:der1;ex:e2, ex:e1)
wasDerivedFrom(ex:der2;ex:e1, ex:e2)
endDocument
